QuestInfo.name: A Hero's Duty 2
QuestInfo.0: The citizens were attacked and collapsed in the subway. Make sure they are okay.
QuestInfo.1: Some people were left behind in the subway cars. Go save them.
QuestInfo.2: It seems that's all, but ask one more time to make sure.

1.msg: #b(They couldn't have just disappeared... )#k \r\nHey! Are there more people back there?

2.msg: Huh? Y-yeah! My girlfriend is there! She tripped while running and... I... we got separated! Please save my girlfriend.

no.0: I knew it. No one's coming to save us. I'm just going to play dead. I hope my girlfriend is doing the same.

0.msg: Hey, are you okay? Look at me.

2.msg: Your boyfriend is waiting in the next car. It's clear, go to him.

3.msg: Sniff... thank you. I can't believe he left me here! It's a good thing he survived, so I can break up with him!

0.msg: #b(You'll feel better once all the monsters are defeated. Defeat them all and then talk to the citizen.)#k
